chapter: Dave Bailey: recording and learning to play
title: Closing and plans for Saturday recording and parade
summary: Interviewer closes and discusses rehearsal and a Saturday recording and parade.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: It's just in there. Well, listen, I think that'll be all we need. Okay? Yeah. So... I think that'll get enough to get a good story on here. You think I'll play all right? Yeah, fine. You come to rehearse tomorrow night or rehearse in the morning? Yeah. I'm gonna try to get there. Because we're doing that recording Saturday, see? Yeah. Try to come tomorrow night. I will. You know that Saturday? Yeah. At Washington Avenue. Yeah. Over there, at Barnes. And we gotta play a parade. Have you? Yeah, we gotta play a parade. You gotta record it Saturday, you know. Right? You gotta record it Saturday, too. Saturday? Yeah. Spears didn't tell you about that? No, he told me not. No, maybe he's gonna tell you tomorrow, then. Tomorrow night. Okay, Dick, that's about it. . . .
